hints.text: To get $x$ by itself, undo what is being done to it. What undoes adding $5$?
Subtract $5$ from both sides of the equation. The right side becomes $12 - 5$.
$12 - 5 = 7$, so the solution of the equation is $x = 7$.

explanation: In $x + 5 = 12$, the number $5$ is added to $x$.
Subtract $5$ from both sides, since subtracting undoes adding and keeps the equation balanced.
This leaves $x = 12 - 5$ on its own, which works out to $x = 7$.
Check: $7 + 5 = 12$ is true, so the solution is $x = 7$.
